description: This file contains functions and types for normalizing and finalizing inbound message contexts, including handling text fields, media types, and conversation labels in a messaging application.

methods.name: normalizeTextField
methods.description: Normalizes a text field by sanitizing inbound system tags and newlines if the input is a string.

methods.name: normalizeMediaType
methods.description: Trims and validates a media type string, returning undefined if invalid.

methods.name: countMediaEntries
methods.description: Counts the number of media entries in the context based on MediaPaths, MediaUrls, MediaPath, and MediaUrl.

methods.name: finalizeInboundContext
methods.description: Main function that normalizes and finalizes the inbound message context, including text fields, media types, labels, and authorization flags.
